<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-reference.mjs from inventory/atoms.json. Do not edit by hand. -->
Every Software Factory, Belai and Pix route the API serves. Routes under `/v1/factory` and `/v1/belai` need a signed-in console session (or an API key) and act on the caller's tenant. Internal routes are called by schedulers and the Pix call worker with a signed header, not by people.
